english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a physical cushion or pad, including a seat pad and the specialist gold-leaf pad.

examples.english: I put a cushion on the hard chair, and it is much more comfortable to sit.
examples.traditional: 我喺張硬櫈上面放咗個墊子，坐得舒服好多。
